name: cloud-keyboard-libs
description: Cloud Keyboard — Feature Pack APK. Bundles libs:media (stickers/GIF), libs:translate (ML Kit), and libs:voice (Vosk) as a companion APK updatable independently of the keyboard.

android._doc_abi_filters: Native-library ABIs shipped in the APK. Vosk + JNA ship ~25MB of .so PER ABI; with no filter AGP bundled all 7 the deps carry (x86_64, x86, arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, mips, mips64, armeabi) = 99.5MB of a 129.7MB APK. mips/mips64 were removed from the NDK in 2018 and are dead weight. arm64-v8a only mirrors ea_cloud-superapp + ea_cloud-vault and lands the APK at ~55MB. Add 'x86_64' here for Waydroid/emulator and rebuild — no gradle edits needed.
android._doc_version: version_code/version_name live here, not in app/build.gradle. libs/keyboard is shared by reference and reads ${rootDir}/build.json, so these are what the keyboard APK's BuildConfig reports - they used to resolve to ea_cloud-superapp's because the module read a relative path.

libs:media._doc_dir: Shared BY REFERENCE from ea_cloud-superapp/libs/ - settings.gradle points projectDir here instead of at a local copy. These paths used to be hardcoded as include/projectDir pairs in settings.gradle, which meant the module graph lived in two places and neither knew about the other. build.json is now the only place a module is declared.

modules._doc: Feature libs are shared from ../ea_cloud-superapp/libs/ via relative project references in settings.gradle.

keyboard_media._doc: Same block as ea_cloud-superapp and ea_cloud-keyboard — shared vault secret. build.sh sops-decrypts vault_secrets → GIPHY_API_KEY env var → Gradle BuildConfig → MediaRuntime.configure().

signing._doc: ONE shared Cloud-constellation signing key for ALL Android apps. build.sh::_resolve_signing resolves $VAULT_DIR + sops-decrypts the passwords. NO fallback.

release._doc_kind: 'lib' = a companion APK that ships engines behind AIDL bound services instead of UI. data/regen.sh copies this into constellation-fleet.json; the SuperApp's Constellation page files it under the Libs tab instead of Apps. Absent/anything else = 'app'.
